Commit 3f099f80 (branch work/fslr32k-public-api, not pushed). Public entry point: scalafim.atlas.StandardSurfaceRoutes.fsLR32kFrom2009c(pointMap, hemispheres, policy) [shared] and scalafim.atlas.io.StandardSurfaceRouteFiles.fsLR32kFrom2009c(policy = StandardRoutePolicy.Frozen, roots = TemplateFlowCache.roots) [JVM] -> Either[StandardRouteRefusal, Fslr32kRoute]; Fslr32kRoute.admit(source, hemisphere, semantics) -> Either[StandardRouteRefusal, AdmittedSurfaceRoute] (route binds a source grid, hence two steps). Lock Fslr32kFrom2009c (transform = TemplateFlowXfm.Mni6ToMni2009c, manifest/midthickness/nomedialwall digests, FrameBasis.PublisherMethods Van Essen 2012 p.2245); bridge BridgeExactness.Approximate(PointwiseFixedPoint(policy)); StandardRoutePolicy.Frozen = InversePolicy.Default, overriding(policy, reason) explicit; refusals AssetsMissing/AssetRefused/NotLocked/PolicyRefused/Route/PlacementGate; StandardRouteIdentity token = sha256 of canonical text; StandardRouteDisclosure.fields. surface/reference main unchanged; atlas JVM tests depend on surface.jvm test->test. Moved RealPointwiseInverseSuite -> atlas Fslr32kRouteBudgetSuite, FslrBridgeDisagreement -> scalafim.atlas.reference (atlasJVM/Test/runMain), FslrRouteExample.real -> atlas Fslr32kRouteExample. Docs: modules/atlas/README.md "Standard Surface Routes", pointer in modules/surface/README.md.
Gates: `python3 tools/build/sbt-warm atlasJVM/test surfaceJVM/test scalafimCompileAll` -> atlasJVM Passed 121 Skipped 9 of 130; surfaceJVM Passed 268 Skipped 11 of 279; scalafimCompileAll exit 0, no code warnings. `SBT_WARM_HEAP=6g python3 tools/build/sbt-warm atlasJS/test` -> 84 passed (default 3g server OOMed in the Scala.js optimizer); `surfaceJS/test` -> 223 passed, 2 skipped.
GAP: real assets absent on this host (~/Library/Caches/templateflow fsLR/GM/xfm files are zero-byte placeholders; no .templateflow4s point map), so the real-asset tests (P1-P3/P5/P6 budgets through the public route, wiring equivalence, override gate, consumer example) SKIPPED and the FslrBridgeDisagreement runner was not executed. Assembly from files is JVM-only (medial-wall reader is JVM-only); shared lock/policy/identity/refusal contract runs on JS. Not closing: needs a run on a host with the locked cache, with SCALAFIM_REQUIRE_REAL_ASSETS=1 atlasJVM/test plus the P4 disagreement runner.
